description: Treasury is unfunded and shows CAD 0 in verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available with zero classified events and five unclassified sources, so buyer demand remains unknown. The retrieved Lemon Squeezy activation and payout documents support preparing a private checkout packet for the existing SQLite exercise. Activation still depends on seller eligibility and authorization, and the packet depends on identifying the exact archive and its redistribution rights. The catalogue example has a nine-file dry run and an existing reviewer handoff. A qualifying approval for that exact digest is the trigger for publication through the host gate. Checkout preparation can proceed independently.
